rules.name: xoga747-02-vol-id-legacy-vs-dev
rules.sql: SELECT product_code, COUNT(*) AS vol_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT bbg_opt_ticker) AS bbg_tickers, LEFT(CAST(MAX(expiry_date) AS CHAR), 10) AS max_expiry FROM dbsystemuat.vol_id_table GROUP BY product_code

SELECT product_code, COUNT(*) AS vol_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT bbg_opt_ticker) AS bbg_tickers, LEFT(MAX(expiry_date)::text, 10) AS max_expiry FROM opera.vol_id_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY product_code

SELECT pm.bbg_product_code, pm.invenio_product_code, pm.asset_class, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbsystemuat.vol_id_table v WHERE v.product_code = pm.invenio_product_code) AS vol_id_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbsystemuat.underlying_list_table u WHERE u.invenio_product_code = pm.invenio_product_code) AS underlying_rows FROM dbsystemuat.product_master_table pm WHERE pm.bbg_product_code IN ('BJ','IR','JB','XM','YM','YPO','ZB') ORDER BY pm.bbg_product_code
SELECT product_code, COUNT(*) AS vol_ids_with_ticker FROM dbsystemuat.vol_id_table WHERE product_code IN ('BN BJ','MM IR','BN JB','BN XM','BN YM','BN YPO','MM ZB') GROUP BY product_code

expect.reason: legacy and dev should hold the same vol ids per product (a gap means a migration issue)
the financial roots exist in the legacy product master
